ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Libvlc.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "libvlc.dll", a DLL that is legitimately used by "VLC.exe" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\libvlc\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\VideoLAN\\\\VLC\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\VideoLAN\\\\VLC\\\\")))
